avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces sunitinib plasma concentration by 50%+ via increased hepatic metabolism
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication - do not use concurrently; allow 2-week washout if recently used

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases sunitinib concentration and toxicity risk

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 induction may reduce sunitinib efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to discontinue; monitor for reduced drug response

avoid_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition and potential increased QT prolongation risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; maintain <500mg daily if used

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase sunitinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased toxicity signs (fatigue, hypertension); dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginger (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition and anticoagulant properties; sunitinib carries bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Limit to culinary amounts (<1g daily); counsel on bleeding precautions

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction; may modestly decrease sunitinib concentration
caution_supplements.action: Monitor response; counsel patient to maintain consistent intake

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically increases sunitinib bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required throughout therapy; includes pomelo and Seville oranges

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase sunitinib absorption and peak plasma concentration
caution_foods.action: Take sunitinib consistently with or without food; maintain uniform feeding pattern

caution_foods.name: Licorice
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate hypertension risk; sunitinib commonly causes HTN
caution_foods.action: Avoid excessive licorice consumption; monitor blood pressure closely

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (in context of hypertension)
caution_foods.mechanism: Sunitinib-induced hypertension may be compounded; minimal direct interaction
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderation of aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes, liver function, and signs of toxicity (handfoot syndrome, fatigue, bleeding). Ensure strict CYP3A4 inducer/inhibitor avoidance as sunitinib has narrow therapeutic window with significant toxicity at elevated levels.
